recipes.name: Cheap & Easy Puff Pastry with Frozen Strawberries
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cut the puff pastry into nine 4x4” (10x10cm) squares and arrange onto the prepared baking sheet.
Bake in the oven for 15-18 minutes, or until golden brown and beautifully puffed. Set aside to cool.
Once cooled, split a baked puff pastry in half and place the bottom half onto a serving plate.
Spoon 2 generous dollops of whipped cream onto the bottom half.
Grate a frozen strawberry over the whipped cream.
Top with the remaining half of puff pastry, another dollop of whipped cream, fresh sliced strawberries, a drizzle of sweetened condensed milk and a final grating of frozen strawberry.
